nodes.name: tierOf
nodes.body_text: tierOf = (g: Ram): Tier => (g === "mac" ? TIERS[7] : TIERS.find((t) => t.max !== undefined && g <= t.max)!)

nodes.name: parseGb
nodes.body_text: parseGb = (v?: string | string[]): Ram | null => { if (v === "mac") return "mac"; const x = typeof v === "string" ? Number(v) : NaN; return Number.isFinite(x) && x > 0 && x <= 4096 ? x : null; }

nodes.name: gbParam
nodes.body_text: gbParam = (g: Ram) => (g === "mac" ? "mac" : String(+g.toPrecision(6)))

nodes.name: fmtRam
nodes.body_text: fmtRam = (g: Ram) => g === "mac" ? "M-series Mac" : g >= 1 ? `${+g.toFixed(2)} GB` : g >= 0.001 ? `${+(g * 1024).toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.round(g * 1048576)} KB`

nodes.name: hash
nodes.body_text: hash = (s: string) => { let h = 2166136261; for (const c of s) { h ^= c.charCodeAt(0); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } return h >>> 0; }

nodes.name: caseNo
nodes.body_text: caseNo = (g: Ram, n: string) => `ALT-${(hash(gbParam(g) + n) % 900000) + 100000}`

nodes.name: util
nodes.body_text: util = (g: Ram, n: string) => (4 + (hash(n + gbParam(g)) % 10) / 10).toFixed(1)

nodes.name: cleanName
nodes.body_text: cleanName = (v?: string | string[]) => (typeof v === "string" ? v.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N} ._'-]/gu, "").slice(0, 24).trim() : "")

nodes.name: donorOf
nodes.body_text: donorOf = (t: Tier) => DONOR[t.id]
